description: This file defines a Java interface 'JournalEntryAggregationWriterService' which declares methods related to writing journal entry aggregation data, including batch inserts, tracking, and rollback operations.

classes.name: JournalEntryAggregationWriterService
classes.description: Java interface for journal entry aggregation write operations including insertion and rollback of summaries and tracking data.

methods.name: insertJournalEntrySummaryBatch
methods.description: Inserts a batch of journal entry summaries.

methods.name: insertJournalEntryTracking
methods.description: Inserts a journal entry tracking record; may throw an exception.

methods.name: rollbackJournalEntrySummary
methods.description: Performs a rollback of journal entry summaries for a specific job execution ID.

methods.name: rollbackJournalEntryTracking
methods.description: Performs a rollback of journal entry tracking for a specific job execution ID.
